event_text: An outside party is in Fugaku's operational network, entering through the public status dashboard
Suspicious network traffic is detected; RIKEN starts an investigation with its maintenance provider
RIKEN suspends Fugaku and blocks outside access
RIKEN tells the education ministry that keys giving administrator access to Fugaku's servers were taken; it cuts outside access and replaces the keys
notes: Per the minister's Nov 17 press conference.

event_text: RIKEN publishes its first notice and explains the incident to the Saitama and Hyogo police
notes: The notice is dated Nov 16 and was posted Nov 17.

event_text: RIKEN publishes its second notice: 430 stolen keys, 4,222 Fugaku users
Japan's education and science minister says the ministry will move quickly to strengthen security across the national research computing network
The ministry asks other supercomputer operators to check their systems; an investigative committee with outside experts is announced
